amount.description: Fee amount as a decimal string

assetId.description: Asset ID that the fee is denominated in

billedTo.description: Party responsible for paying the fee

metadata.description: Optional display and audit metadata for the fee

pastDueWindow.description: Grace period after the due date before the fee is marked as past due

dueDate.description: Date by which the fee must be paid

loanId.description: Loan ID this fee belongs to

paymentId.description: Payment ID if this fee has been settled

dueStatus.description: The due status of the fee

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp when the fee was resolved

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the fee was created
